abstract: Low temperature is a key environmental factor limiting plant growth. Under low-temperature stress, the biological membrane serves as the primary site of damage, with its lipid compositions undergoing significant alterations that are closely related to plant cold resistance. Ammopiptanthus mongolicus is an evergreen broad-leaved plant with exceptionally high stress tolerance, endemic to cold and arid desert areas. However, the regulatory mechanism of low-temperature induced membrane lipid metabolism remains unclear. In this study, an integrated approach combining physiological analyses, lipidomic profiling and gene functional validation was employed to elucidate the low-temperature response mechanism of Ammopiptanthusmongolicus. The results showed that low-temperature stress significantly increased the relative electrolyte conductivity, as well as the content of malondialdehyde, proline, soluble sugar, soluble protein and chlorophyll, along with the activity of superoxide dismutase in Ammopiptanthus mongolicus. Lipidomic analysis identified a total of 569 lipid molecules, among which glycerophospholipids constituted the predominant fraction. Low temperature induced lipid remodeling in Ammopiptanthus mongolicus, with 31 metabolites significantly upregulated and 26 metabolites significantly downregulated. The levels of phosphatidylserine, lysophospholipid, monogalactosyldiacylglycerol (MGDG) and glycosylceramide increased markedly, whereas the contents of phosphatidylcholine (PC) and triacylglycerol (TG) declined significantly. Furthermore, the proportions of polyunsaturated fatty acids in phosphatidic acid, PC, phosphatidylethanolamine (PE), diacylglycerol, and MGDG were significantly elevated. The real-time fluorescence quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction analysis revealed that low temperature markedly upregulated the expressions of fatty acid desaturase genes AmFAD2, AmFAD7, AmFAD8 and sphingolipid desaturase gene Am8SLD, while the expression of AmFAD3 and AmFAD6 were downregulated. Overexpression of AmFAD8 in Arabidopsisthaliana improved its freezing tolerance as well as membrane stability and antioxidant capacity under low-temperature stress. In summary, lipid molecules play a crucial role in the response of Ammopiptanthus mongolicus to low-temperature stress. This study fills the research gap regarding the cold adaptation mechanisms of extreme desert plants at the lipidomic level and provides critical theoretical support for the genetic improvement of cold-tolerant crops and forest trees.

ChinaSheng Wu Gong Cheng Xue Bao94264631000-3061IMCold TemperatureLipid MetabolismphysiologyStress, PhysiologicalphysiologyLipidomics低温是限制植物生长的关键环境因子。在低温胁迫下，生物膜是最先受到损伤的部位，其脂质组成会发生显著变化，这些变化与植物的低温应答密切相关。蒙古沙冬青是寒旱荒漠区特有的强耐逆常绿阔叶植物，为了研究其低温诱导的膜脂代谢调控机制，本研究采用生理学、脂质组学和基因功能验证相结合的方法解析沙冬青的低温响应机制。结果表明，低温胁迫导致沙冬青相对电导率、丙二醛、脯氨酸、可溶性糖、可溶性蛋白和叶绿素含量以及超氧化物歧化酶活性显著增加。脂质组共鉴定出569种脂质分子，其中甘油磷脂为主要组分。低温诱导沙冬青发生脂质重塑，31种代谢产物显著上调，26种代谢产物显著下调;磷脂酰丝氨酸、溶血磷脂、单半乳糖基甘油二酯(monogalactosyldiacylglycerol, MGDG)和糖基神经酰胺含量显著增加，磷脂酰胆碱(phosphatidylcholine, PC)和甘油三酯(triacylglycerol, TG)含量显著下降;磷脂酸、PC、磷脂酰乙醇胺(phosphatidylethanolamine, PE)、甘油二酯和MGDG中的多不饱和脂肪酸含量显著增加。实时荧光定量逆转录聚合酶链式反应结果显示，低温诱导会使脂肪酸去饱和酶(fatty acid desaturase, FAD)基因AmFAD2、AmFAD7、AmFAD8和鞘氨醇长链基Δ8去饱和酶(sphingolipid desaturase, SLD)基因Am8SLD表达显著上调，AmFAD3和AmFAD6表达下调。将AmFAD8在拟南芥中过表达可增加其抗冻性以及低温胁迫下细胞膜的稳定性和抗氧化胁迫能力。综上所述，脂质分子在沙冬青响应低温胁迫中起着关键作用。本研究填补了极端荒漠植物冷适应机制在脂质组学层面的研究空白，为耐寒农作物及林木的遗传改良提供了重要理论支撑。.Ammopiptanthus mongolicusfatty acid desaturaselipid remodelinglow temperature作者声明没有任何可能会影响本文所报告工作的已知经济利益或个人关系。2026102453620261024535202610232353ppublish4292022710.13345/j.cjb.2601291000-3061(2026)10-4599-17SACHDEV S, ANSARI SA, ANSARI MI, FUJITA M, HASANUZZAMAN M.
